name: Bengaluru Urban revenue maps — taluk, hobli, village, survey number
licence: As published by the OpenCity urban data portal
attribution: Revenue maps via OpenCity Urban Data Portal
transformation: One KML per hobli sheet; TALUK/HOBLI/VILLAGE and survey number read from each placemark's description; geometry converted to GeoJSON
caveats: COVERAGE IS PARTIAL — only the taluks and hoblis published in this dataset are present. Points outside them return UNAVAILABLE.
A survey number from a digitised revenue sheet is INDICATIVE. It is not a legal determination of boundary or title; those are settled by the Sub-Registrar and a licensed surveyor.
Sheet vintage is not stated per file; treat as historical and re-verify before relying on it.
